title: Request for proposal for click and collect operations
not_questions: Real-Time CDP is outside our scope.
Use three pilot stores for all examples.
Keep warehouse replacement outside the commercial offer.

questions.label: A.1
questions.text: Describe how Adobe Commerce would reserve the last tent in a store while a customer completes payment for collection.

questions.label: A.2
questions.text: Explain how Adobe Commerce would reverse a reservation after a store associate finds that the packaged tent is damaged.

questions.label: A.3
questions.text: Specify the Adobe Commerce checks required when a customer changes the pickup store after paying with a gift card.

questions.label: A.4
questions.text: Describe the Adobe Commerce pilot evidence that would let operations confirm collection orders are ready within two hours.

questions.label: B.1
questions.text: Explain how AEM Assets would match supplier images in Amazon S3 to a product that has four sizes and three fabric colours.

questions.label: B.2
questions.text: Describe the AEM Assets approval route for a stove photograph that omits the supplier's required clearance label.

questions.label: B.3
questions.text: Set out how AEM Assets would replace a recalled tent image distributed through Akamai and how a store would verify the correction.

questions.label: B.4
questions.text: Provide an AEM Assets test for finding camping photographs whose usage rights expire before the summer catalogue opens.

questions.label: C.1
questions.text: Describe a Customer Journey Analytics report that shows which pilot store most often loses customers after they select a collection time.

questions.label: C.2
questions.text: Explain how a Customer Journey Analytics analyst could reconcile collection reservations from Adobe Commerce with the number of fulfilled orders.

questions.label: D.1
questions.text: Identify the retail operations lead on your proposed team and the days that person can visit the pilot stores.

questions.label: D.2
questions.text: Provide two retailer references that changed their store collection process during a peak trading period.

questions.label: D.3
questions.text: State your proposed support coverage on summer weekends and the additional charge for a second on-call engineer.

questions.label: D.4
questions.text: Describe the handover materials your firm supplies to store managers when a regional pilot closes.
